summary: Static verification for Minecraft Fabric mod 'Native Client' (Java project, no web app). Ran the exact Gradle command requested: compileJava, compileUi26Java, compileUimcJava, compileTestJava with JDK 25 — all four source sets compiled successfully (exit 0). Did NOT run game, build, jar, test, or release per user instruction. Performed thorough code review of the three changed areas.

code_review_findings.UiRuntime.onKey (line ~574-583, openHub: Correct. In-world + no screen + menuKey (Right Shift) with no CTRL/ALT/SUPER modifiers → openHub() which does mc.setScreen(mc.newHost(McBridge.HUD, null)) — the HUD editor hub. The capturing branch at lines 556-570 still closes HUD or MENU hosts when the menu key is pressed inside them (also saves Modules). No regression.
code_review_findings.StatusModules.Effects.render done() righ: Correct. Both List and Row layouts now call done(width + 2*pad + 4*s, ...). The bar background in List layout (lines 263-264) is still drawn at x+pad with width = inner, so the bar no longer stretches to the card's right edge — leaves pad + 4*s gap. Text at tx = x+pad also leaves right padding. 'Infinite' no longer touches the card edge. Row layout bar at tx+s with width tw[i] - 2*s is unchanged relative to its tile; the extra 4*s only increases outer card width — safe.
code_review_findings.StatusModules.Armor List layout (lines 4: Correct. tw and w are computed OUTSIDE the `if (ui != null)` guard so measure (ui==null) and draw paths produce identical sizes. done(w + 2*pad + (tw>0 ? 4*s : 0), n*tile + (n-1)*rowGap + 2*pad). Draw text at tx = x+pad+tile+7*s with width tw, giving right padding of pad + 4*s. For empty slots sl.empty() → label returns '' safely (no NPE on sl.id). Wear bar under number only when worn && bar.value && tw>0. Min text column of '000' enforced (line 431). ellipsize at 96*s applied. No tiny-centered-square issue in the List layout anymore — each row shows a soft rounded tile + label beside it, even if n==1.
code_review_findings.StatusModules.Armor Row layout (lines 46: Still uses label(sl, false) and drawSlot — compiles. For empty slots in Row layout drawSlot still shows the small inner square, but the user complaint was about the List layout (held-item-only case), so this is out of scope.
code_review_findings.Canvas/Status helpers: Canvas.ellipsize, Canvas.round and Status.title/wear are used consistently with existing signatures (verified via compile).
